# Workflow Analysis

`dev` is the default integration branch and `main` is release-only. Atomic issue branches follow `feat-issue-<number>` or `bug-issue-<number>`. Every implementation uses accepted ADR → accepted PRD → accepted ticket → exact-base packet → RED with expected reason → minimum GREEN → focused/full/build/manual → cumulative exact-head review → exact-head CI. A contract, fixture, oracle, lockfile, runtime, permission, or head change invalidates affected evidence.
